title: Source temperature vs 100 C supply
rationale: Reservoir at 2500 m is 94.5 C, 5.5 K below the fixed 100 C supply before any losses, so a HEX alone cannot supply 100 C. Options: (a) deeper well - T_res = 100 C needs 2667 m, and direct HEX supply (T_res >= 107.4 C incl. 5 K approach, 0.4 K surface drops, ~2 K wellbore loss) needs ~2891 m; (b) surface upgrade - heat pump on the brine leaving the HEX plus CHP on the produced gas. Decision: start with (b) at the official 2500 m (no extrapolated reservoir data, least drilling), then climb a 250 m depth ladder (max 4000 m) and keep each step only if emissions fall >= 5%; the ranking decides with numbers.
